summary.name: Prezi
summary.one_liner: Prezi is a cloud-based presentation software for creating interactive, visually engaging presentations, with an AI option that generates a presentation from a prompt.
use_cases: generating a presentation with AI from a prompt
making visually engaging slides without design skills
sharing presentations online from the cloud
summary.what_it_does: Prezi is a cloud-based presentation tool for building dynamic, interactive presentations. The page is a login screen, so it shows little about specific features. It advertises Prezi AI, which creates a custom presentation in seconds from user input and requires no design skills. The page describes the product as presentation software that helps users bring ideas to life. Accounts are managed through a web login and sign-up flow. Specific editing features and export options are not described on this page.
notable: Prezi AI creates a custom presentation in seconds
No design skills needed, per the page
caveats: Pricing tiers and paid plan details are not stated on this page; freemium status comes from the directory listing
